correctness.rationale: Actual RESULT.md gives a disjoint anchored-coordinate stratification: ordinary range≤1 charts with total volume N and exceptional range>1 charts indexed by 2m oriented missing edges, each carrying beta variable L=2−range with density (N−1)L^(N−2). Exceptional volume 2m/(N−1) and total T/(N−1) follow with no overlap away from boundaries. Conditional independent uniform remaining coordinates yield EL²=(N−1)/(N+1), E(2−L)²=(N²+3N+4)/(N(N+1)), so mixing ordinary covariance (N+2)/(12N)P with exceptional terms gives exactly A=(N−1)(N²+3N+2m+2)/(12(N+1)T), B=(N²+3N+4)/(N(N+1)T), C=(N−1)/(6(N+1)T). An independent SymPy simplification checked all three coefficient identities, without relying on stored logs. The four orthogonal H-subspaces have top eigenvalue A+B−C on matched antisymmetric differences; B>C strictly for every N≥3, including s=0 and m=1. U_ab=−1/2 exactly on missing pairs. The exact lattice/Ehrhart checker was inspected: it covers only eight N≤6 cases and is not the infinite proof.
